chosen: Qwen-ASR-Realtime through same-origin Node WebSocket proxy

sources.finding: Official 16kHz PCM microphone streaming demo; useful reference for incremental transcription. Self-hosted model deployment is unnecessary for the existing cloud-key prototype.
Alternative speech-to-text library with voice activity detection and realtime callbacks; useful architecture reference, not included as a runtime dependency.
Node WebSocket client/server library used by this integration; browser uses its native WebSocket.
session.update, PCM input_audio_buffer.append, server VAD and session.finish.
Partial text plus stash is replaceable; completed transcript is authoritative.

limitations: Partial hypotheses can be corrected, including provisional language or words.
LLM and speech generation still follow a confirmed utterance.
Public server quota remains shared; no phone microphone or outdoor wind test was performed.
